name: paper-whiel-tools
notes: Whiel + Tools (tools, no skills): the GPT-5.5 stage of the paper's 'base' configuration over the full benchmark. This first GPT-5.5 pass is capped at 6 iterations; the reported counts then rerun its failures from scratch with iteration_limit null (uncapped), before escalating. Escalation: rerun the remaining failures (set 'inputs' to them) with model 'gpt-5.6-sol', then with model 'gpt-6-astra'; the gpt-6-astra stage needs Codex CLI 0.154.0 (provider_cli artifacts/provider-cli/0.154.0/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/codex), because 0.148.0 rejects that model. Each stage is a fresh attempt with no prior state. The recorded runs used the default (neutral) prompt.
